grip.note: held upright like the sun staff

note: Admiral Vael's trident (Tidecallers), hand-authored at 1 texel a px: a dark wet driftwood shaft with gilt rings and crown, a sea-blue band, three barbed gilt prongs and a pearl at the fork; held upright. Tier III: a sea-blue lower band, a broader crossbar and a longer middle prong; adds pearl tips on the outer prongs.
